newsitem.title: USA: Hi-Lo Automotive posts Q3 loss on charges.
newsitem.headline: Hi-Lo Automotive posts Q3 loss on charges.

text.p: Hi-Lo Automotive Inc said Thursday it posted a third quarter loss of $51.7 million including charges compared to a profit of $0.6 milion.
The loss per share was $4.80, compared to earnings of $0.06 a share last year.

The loss includes pre-tax charges of $59.4 million: including $3.8 million to cost of goods sold as a result of valuing certain inventories at their realizable values which is less than original costs; $4.3 million of operating, selling, general and administrative expenses for store occupancy costs; and $51.4 million provision for asset impairment and store closings. The $51.4 million includes $37.7 million of intangibles, primarily cost in excess of net assets acquired (goodwill), and $13.7 million for store closings and liquidation of real estate previously acquired for future expansion.
Hi-Lo said it does not expect future charges of this nature.
Sales for the third quarter ended September 30, 1996 were $64.4 million, about 11 percent lower than the $72.2 million a year ago, Hi-Lo said, and same store sales fell 11.5 percent.

For the nine months, sales were $192.3 million compared to $203.4 million a year ago. Same store sales fell 7.5 percent. Net loss for the nine-month period, after giving effect to the charges described above, was $51.9 million compared to net income of $2.9 million 1995. Net loss per share for the nine-months was $4.83 compared to net income of $.27 in 1995.
The stock fell 17 percent, off 1/2 to 2-3/8.
